headline: Cuzzilla (Cida): "Fewer than 19% of taxpayers support almost two-thirds of the entire Irpef, now a change of course"
summary: Cida's Cuzzilla said fewer than 19% of taxpayers support almost two-thirds of the entire Irpef, calling for a change of course on redistribution.
why: Irpef is Italy's personal income tax, and changes to its burden shape public finances, household incomes and the government's fiscal policy.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Cuzzilla (Cida): "Meno del 19% dei contribuenti sostiene quasi due terzi dell'intera Irpef, ora cambio di rotta"
